claims.statement: The Company has set specific targets to be achieved by FY 2030 across various ESG areas including Energy Conservation, Product Stewardship, Water Neutrality, Nature Positive, Customer Celebrations, Community Ownership, Water Stewardship, Energising, Equitable & Inclusive Workplace, Safe Workplace, World Class Governance, and Sustainable Supply Chain Management.

facts.statement: The Company spent 121.7 Crores on R&T expenses during FY 2025-26.
facts.quote: The Company has spent ` 121.7 Crores and `122.8 Crores (only operating cost) on R&T expenses, during FY 2025-26 and FY 2024-25, respectively.

facts.statement: The Company maintains an in-house Research & Technology (R&T) facility where scientists work on sustainable product innovations.
facts.quote: The Company has an in-house Research & Technology (R&T) facility, where experts and scientists work on various innovations/technologies, including developing pathways for bringing on more sustainable and environment friendly products.
